prompt: Which gaps can go on a POA&M for our CMMC Level 2 self-assessment, and for how long?
assertions: States the two-part conditional-status gate: minimum score (≥88 of 110, i.e., ≥0.8×110) AND only specific practices eligible
States eligibility: only 1-point weighted practices may be on the POA&M — no 5-point (and highest-weight) items
States the closeout window: 180 days to remediate and close the POA&M or conditional status lapses
Notes the affirmation mechanics: senior official affirms at conditional status and again at final status after POA&M closeout

Distinguishes POA&M-eligible gaps from DFARS 7012 baseline duties that cannot be deferred (e.g., incident reporting), and notes suspension-era caveat: these rules govern the self-assessment tracks currently in force
